title: Nile Crocodiles in Tanzania
excerpt: Nile crocodiles are a feature of many Tanzanian rivers, from the Mara to the Rufiji. Facts and where to see them.
body:
## Size

Nile crocodiles can grow very large; big males can exceed five metres.

## Hunting

They wait in the water and strike suddenly, as seen during the [river crossings](/blog/great-migration-river-crossings/).

## Basking

They lie on riverbanks with open mouths to regulate temperature.

## Where

- Mara and Grumeti rivers in the Serengeti.
- Rufiji River in Nyerere.
- Katavi.

## Safety

Never swim in rivers or lakes unless locals confirm it is safe.
